claim: Estimated relative food-insecurity risk of the province in the target quarter: an indicator-based structural level (LightGBM, trained without the province's own region) plus the province's measured HFIAS history, weighted by how strongly measured deviations persisted between survey rounds (a permanent province component; no time decay is identified). Validated survey-to-survey only, on re-used development folds; the quarter-to-quarter change is NOT validated, because no quarterly provincial measurement exists.
class_rule: HIGH if P >= 0.8, the whole refit range >= 0.5 and every candidate model >= 0.5; LOW if P <= 0.2, the whole refit range < 0.5 and every candidate model < 0.5; otherwise UNCERTAIN
meaning: Estimated probability that the province's household food insecurity (HFIAS moderate-or-severe) is above the national level in the target quarter. A risk estimate: HIGH does not confirm food insecurity and LOW does not guarantee food security. It is not the share of food-insecure households.
